summary: Iteration 4 regression pass on Groveno Fresh code-quality refactor (stable React keys, useCallback for useEffect deps, extracted nested-ternary helpers). Backend smoke + full regression: 103/103 pytest passing (same as iter3, no server code changed). Frontend regression on both admin (1920x900) and CL (480x900) viewports across every touched page. CRITICAL FINDING: zero new React runtime warnings — no 'Each child in a list should have a unique key' warnings, no 'React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency' warnings, and zero console errors on: Login, Dashboard, Products (search + Add), ProductForm (variants small/medium/large + nutrition add), Categories, Orders (25 rows + filters), OrderDetail, Users (37 users + detail), CLs, Wallet, Reports (20 SVGs incl. Recharts BarChart/PieChart + Export CSV button), Express Pickup ('Live' badge visible with SSE connected, 5+ pickup cards render with getCardTone borders). CL panel: Login, Dashboard (4 stat cards), Orders (3 tabs + search + bulk btn), Bulk Order (customer-0 + add-customer -> customer-1 both with stable _key), Order Detail, Earnings (balance + 3 mini stats), QR (image + code text), Profile (code + bank details). Bottom-nav walk across all 5 tabs works. No key duplication, no state bleed between rows, no focus loss when adding rows. All existing functionality preserved.

issues: Non-blocking carry-over: react-router v7_startTransition and v7_relativeSplatPath future flag warnings still present from previous iterations. Not introduced by this iteration. Ignored by test filter as documented in review request.

action_items: None - refactor is clean. No regressions. Zero new React warnings introduced.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor scope respected user constraints: localStorage token keys ('groveno_admin_token', 'groveno_cl_token') untouched; UI/styling unchanged; only code quality improvements made.

Stable key strategy is consistent across files: prefers real IDs (p.id, _id) then falls back to composite (productId+variantSize+i, name+revenue, pincode+i). Fallback with array index as final tiebreaker is acceptable since these lists are not reorderable at runtime.

useCallback wrapping of load functions and including them in useEffect deps is the correct fix. Verified in Dashboard, Products, ProductForm, OrderDetail, UserDetail, ExpressPickup, CLs, CLDashboard, CLOrders, CLOrderDetail, CLEarnings, CLBulkOrder, CLQrCode.

Extracted helpers (renderConnectionBadge, getCardTone, renderList, renderContent, renderTable, renderBody, styleFor, getSubmitLabel, renderCommission) replace nested ternaries and are pure — good separation.

Carry-over from iter3 (still valid but out-of-scope for this iter): CLOrderDetail.jsx fetches all orders via GET /cl/orders?limit=200 and finds client-side; consider adding GET /api/cl/orders/:id. CLQrCode 'ordersFromQR' still uses stats.totalOrders (label misleading). No action required this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all admin pages + all CL pages loaded and interactive with zero new console warnings/errors)
